---
title: "Supprimer un fournisseur"
api: "DELETE https://api.smartbills.io/v1/vendors/{id}"
description: "Supprimer un fournisseur de votre compte"
---

## Authentification

<ParamField header="Authorization" type="string" required>
  Jeton Bearer pour l'authentification
</ParamField>

## Portées requises

- `vendors.write`

## Paramètres de chemin

<ParamField path="id" type="integer" required>
  L'identifiant unique du fournisseur à supprimer
</ParamField>

<Warning>
  **Action destructive** : La suppression d'un fournisseur est permanente et ne peut pas être annulée.
</Warning>

<RequestExample>

```bash cURL
curl --request DELETE \
  --url https://api.smartbills.io/v1/vendors/12345 \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY'
```

```javascript JavaScript
const deleted = await client.vendors.delete(12345);
```

```python Python
deleted = client.vendors.delete(12345)
```

```csharp C#
var deleted = await client.Vendors.DeleteAsync(12345);
```

</RequestExample>

<ResponseExample>

```json Response
{
  "id": 12345,
  "name": "Acme Supplies Inc.",
  "deletedAt": "2024-01-20T16:00:00Z"
}
```

</ResponseExample>
